validate_execution_trace: run the TraceValidator to validate a PyTorch execution trace JSON file and print validation results
count_ops_in_trace: use TraceValidator.num_ops to count the total number of operator nodes in an execution trace
count_comm_ops_in_trace: use TraceValidator.num_comm_ops to count record_param_comms operator nodes in an execution trace
count_triton_ops_in_trace: use TraceValidator.num_triton_ops to count triton kernel operator nodes in an execution trace
review_trace_validation: review the TraceValidator class and its validate method to understand PyTorch trace validation logic
